use default

van_eck() -> Pipe[int] is
    let last_seen = MAP()

    let term mut = 0
    let position mut = 0

    do
        yield term

        let previous mut = 0
        let next =
            if last_seen.try_get_value(term, previous ref) then
                position - previous
            else
                0
            fi

        last_seen[term] = position

        term = next
        position = position + 1
    od
